1.6.0.title: Talk to the Librarian
1.6.0.body: Type /librarian in a note and ask it to tag the note, mark a passage, or file it. It proposes; nothing changes until you tick what you want and apply.

1.6.0.title: Hand a note to your AI
1.6.0.body: Hand to AI turns the note you're in into a ready prompt for Claude Code or another agent: the goal, the open tasks, and what done means. Type /hand to AI, or search for "send to AI".

1.6.0.title: Music while you write
1.6.0.body: Setup now asks about sound, and Settings → General → Ambient audio plays a studio track for your theme from a small player above the sidebar's footer. A video in a tab takes over, and the music comes back when it stops.

1.6.0.title: Claude FM and tucked tabs
1.6.0.body: Pick Claude FM, Anthropic's live lo-fi stream, as your ambient sound, and tuck a tab that's playing into the player to keep it going out of the way.

1.6.0.title: Show only what you use
1.6.0.body: Settings → Appearance → Show in Rotli hides the parts of the title bar, sidebar and tabs you don't need. Each switch says how to reach it without the button.

1.6.0.title: Bold that behaves
1.6.0.body: Bold, italic and the other marks now work across several lines and over text that's only partly bold, with no stray stars left behind.

1.6.0.title: Boards wear your theme
1.6.0.body: A board you haven't colored takes your theme's own color and changes with it. Prefer paper? Settings → Appearance → Board background → White.

1.6.0.title: Chat shows pictures and video
1.6.0.body: When a reply links an image or a video in your vault, you see it right in the thread.

1.6.0.title: Find lights up every match
1.6.0.body: ⌘F now marks every match on the page, and the current one stands out.

1.6.0.title: Tidier note names
1.6.0.body: Settings → General → Leftover note names clears old "Untitled" placeholders and half-typed titles from your notes' metadata in one click, and keeps any name a link still uses.

1.6.0.title: Three new quokka moods
1.6.0.body: Friendly, Inquisitive and Adventurous join the idle moods in Settings → Appearance.

1.6.0.title: A new web vault is ready at once
1.6.0.body: Tasks and your weekly counts include the Welcome lessons the moment your folder connects.
